label: Backend: run all gates (build + vet + test)
command: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...

label: Backend: 1) setup .env
command: test -f .env && echo '.env already exists, not overwriting' || (cp .env.example .env && echo 'Created .env — fill in QISCUS_APP_ID and QISCUS_SECRET_KEY (real, or dummy for local-only smoke test)')

label: Backend: 2) generate dev RSA keypair (JWT, local-only)
command: mkdir -p .dev && openssl genrsa -out .dev/jwt_private.pem 2048 && openssl rsa -in .dev/jwt_private.pem -pubout -out .dev/jwt_public.pem && echo 'Generated .dev/jwt_private.pem + .dev/jwt_public.pem (gitignored, dev-only, never real client keys)'

label: Backend: 3) kill anything still on :8090
command: lsof -nP -iTCP:8090 -sTCP:LISTEN | awk 'NR>1{print $2}' | xargs -r kill -9; echo done

label: Backend: 4) run chat-history-proxy (dev, port 8090)
command: set -a; source .env 2>/dev/null; set +a; export APP_PORT=8090; export JWT_PUBLIC_KEY="$(cat .dev/jwt_public.pem)"; go run ./cmd/chat-history-proxy

label: Backend: 6) generate a dev JWT (sub = your Qiscus login user_id)
Backend: 7) smoke test GET /api/v1/sessions
command: TOKEN=$(go run ./cmd/devtools/gen-dev-jwt -key .dev/jwt_private.pem -sub your-user-id -ttl 168h) && curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8090/api/v1/sessions?fresh=1" && echo
